completion_criteria.text: Audit complete: deny-side and allow-side of .claude/settings.json + settings.local.json assessed under auto mode, findings persisted durably
Maximum-autonomy permission architecture specified, pressure-tested and ratified: guard set D1-D5 plus D6 checkpoint, five-layer design, run mode, ordered change set (R1-R6 ratified 2026-08-13)
Four P0 bugs fixed and verified: block-env-edits.sh exit code, default-branch push prefix gap, supabase db reset contradiction, orphan gh pr review deny
The gating principle (recovery-path + blast-radius, not command name) either ratified or rejected by the user, with a decision record written
The confirmed manual-approval cause (MITOSIS_PATH= env prefix defeating Bash(node:*)) resolved
The cp friction (23 accumulated approvals, largest measured) investigated and addressed
settings.local.json single-use rule accumulation addressed (was 15 -> 58 rules in one session)
Network deny relaxation (curl/wget/http/xh) explicitly adopted with compensating sandbox controls, or explicitly rejected
Hook trust boundary reviewed: the nine hook scripts treated as trusted code on the same tier as permission rules

spine.active_goal: Implement the ratified maximum-autonomy permission architecture: guards only on D1-D5, destructive local work checkpointed, unattended overnight runs that finish every task.
spine.next_step: START HERE. Run the U1-U7 experiments in SPEC section 8 BEFORE implementing any step that depends on one - the SPEC forbids it. Highest value first: U1 (does a hook allow suppress the classifier) and U4 (does tmutil localsnapshot work with no Time Machine destination configured). Then section 6 step 0: narrow protect-claude-config.sh, or the implementation stalls on itself. Open a CHILD thread for the build - this thread carries the ratified design, not the implementation.

open_risks.text: Re-check every line number in the audit report before acting on it — one cite already drifted, so the files have moved under the report and its other line cites may be stale too
Run the seven U1-U7 experiments before implementing any dependent step — the latency budget, the snapshot layer and the gate design all rest on claims the documentation does not settle

Narrow protect-claude-config.sh before touching anything else — it asks on edits under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows}, which is the entire surface of this implementation, so the work stalls on itself

Disable or patch the logbook plugin guard before the first unattended run — any internal exception in it denies the whole Bash/Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit surface with no circuit breaker, freezing the night
Do not reuse the 19ms checkpoint figure — it belongs to git stash create, which was rejected because it cannot capture untracked files; the temp-index replacement is slower and must be re-measured

Ship D2's age-based reaper together with D2 — the agent may not prune the recovery layer, so without a scheduler-run reaper the checkpoint refs and snapshots grow unbounded until macOS thins snapshots silently
Verify every config edit actually went live — converge.mjs auto-promotes on drift but validate.mjs can reject a candidate and leave live pinned to the last-good release with no loud failure

key_decisions.title: Unattended autonomy supersedes alignment with Anthropic's recommended permission defaults
Guard set is D1-D5 with destructive local operations reclassified to checkpoint
Run unattended in bypassPermissions, not auto mode, because auto mode silently skips work
